summary: Batch A6 close-out validated. Core pytest suite (72 tests across A6 late-fills, A3/A4 PANIC locks, A2 order lifecycle, B1 sizing) all green under DB_NAME=ai_trading_bot_test. New HTTP integration suite tests/test_a6_api_integration.py (7 tests) passes against preview backend with STOIC_TESTS_ALLOW_DB_NAME=1 — covers /api/admin/account-position-modes list + set (netting / auto / wrong-password-401 / invalid-value-422), owner /api/accounts position_mode fields, admin ops-console unique_ticket_index, and release-readiness checks.unique_ticket_index. Frontend UI (localhost:3000, Preview Unavailable on public URL for headless) verified: /admin/brokers panel renders 500 rows with mode/source/set testids; dialog exposes all three options plus reason/password/otp inputs; submit correctly disabled until password entered; /admin/ops row ops-unique-ticket-index shows 'OK'; /accounts shows account-position-mode-<number> badge 'POSITIONS · HEDGING · ASSUMED'.

integration_issues.flow: Dev-mode cross-origin csrf (NOT a prod bug)
integration_issues.issue: When FE runs on localhost:3000 but hits REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://stoic-trading-bot.preview.emergentagent.com, document.cookie cannot read csrf_token (set on preview domain), so axios interceptor omits X-CSRF-Token and POST /admin/account-position-modes/{id} returns 403. Same request works from pytest and curl, and will work in prod (same-origin). No code fix needed.

critical_code_review_comments: AccountPositionModesPanel.jsx looks clean (<110 lines, proper useCallback, loading/empty/error states, re-auth gating via disabled submit). No refactor needed.
admin_set_account_position_mode validates mode enum (422), requires re-auth, appends to admin audit chain — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: none; FE SET MODE smoke used existing account 6ac140fec1752ed8b3f19a29 and did not persist due to dev-mode csrf cross-origin limitation; pytest API test uses the same existing account and resets to auto on teardown
context_for_next_testing_agent: To run the HTTP integration suite against the preview: STOIC_TESTS_ALLOW_DB_NAME=1 python -m pytest tests/test_a6_api_integration.py. Pytest unit suite needs DB_NAME=ai_trading_bot_test. CSRF header must be echoed on POSTs — the fixture reads csrf_token cookie and sets X-CSRF-Token. Preview public URL still shows 'Preview Unavailable' to headless browsers; use http://localhost:3000 inside the pod for UI testing.
